verses.text: Wetin dey from di beginning, wetin we don hear, wetin we don see with our eyes, wetin we look at and our hands touch, concerning di Word of life,
and di life show, and we don see am, and we dey bear witness and dey declare to una di life wey no dey end, wey dey with Papa God and show to us,
wetin we don see and hear, we dey declare am to una also, so that una also fit get fellowship with us. Yes, our fellowship na with Papa God and with im Pikin Jesus Christ.
We dey write dis things to una so that our joy go full.
Dis na di message wey we hear from am and dey declare to una: God na light, and darkness no dey inside am at all.
If we talk say we get fellowship with am, and we dey walk inside darkness, we dey lie and we no dey do di truth.
But if we dey walk inside di light, as e dey inside di light, we get fellowship with each other, and di blood of Jesus im Pikin dey clean us from all sin.
If we talk say we no get sin, we dey deceive our own selves, and di truth no dey inside us.
If we confess our sins, e dey faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to clean us from all unrighteousness.
If we talk say we no sin, we dey make am liar, and im word no dey inside us.
My little pikin dem, I dey write dis things to una so that una no go sin. If anybody sin, we get Advocate with Papa God, Jesus Christ di righteous one.
Na im be di sacrifice for our sins, and no be for our own only, but also for di whole world.
By dis we know say we don know am, if we obey im commandments.
Anybody wey talk say, “I know am,” but no obey im commandments, na liar, and di truth no dey inside am.
But anybody wey obey im word, truly God love don reach perfection inside am. By dis we know say we dey inside am.
Anybody wey talk say e dey stay inside am suppose walk even as e walk.
Beloved, I no dey write new commandment to una, but old commandment wey una get from di beginning. Di old commandment na di word wey una don hear.
Again, I dey write new commandment to una, wey true inside am and inside una, because di darkness dey pass away and di true light don dey shine now.
Anybody wey talk say e dey inside di light and e hate im brother, e dey inside darkness till now.
Anybody wey love im brother dey stay inside di light, and nothing dey inside am wey fit make am fall.
But anybody wey hate im brother dey inside darkness and dey walk inside darkness, and e no know wia e dey go, because di darkness don blind im eyes.
I dey write to una, pikin dem, because dem don forgive una your sins for im name sake.

I dey write to una, papa dem, because una know am wey dey from di beginning. I dey write to una, young men, because una don overcome di evil one. I dey write to una, young pikin dem, because una know Papa God.
I don write to una, papa dem, because una know am wey dey from di beginning. I don write to una, young men, because una strong, and God word dey stay inside una, and una don overcome di evil one.
No love di world or di things wey dey inside di world. If anybody love di world, di love of Papa God no dey inside am.
For everything wey dey inside di world, di desire of di flesh, di desire of di eyes, and di pride of life, no come from Papa God but from di world.
Di world dey pass away, with im desires, but anybody wey do God will dey stay forever.
Pikin dem, na di last hour be dis. As una don hear say antichrist dey come, even now plenty antichrists don show. By dis we know say na di last hour.
Dem go out from us, but dem no belong to us; for if dem belong to us, dem for stay with us. But dem go out so that e go show say none of dem belong to us.
Una get anointing from di Holy One, and una all know.
I no write to una because una no know di truth, but because una know am, and because no lie dey come from di truth.
Who be di liar if no be di person wey deny say Jesus na Christ? Dis na antichrist, di one wey deny Papa God and di Pikin.
Anybody wey deny di Pikin no get Papa God. Anybody wey confess di Pikin get Papa God also.
As for una, make wetin una hear from di beginning dey stay inside una. If wetin una hear from di beginning stay inside una, una go also stay inside di Pikin and inside Papa God.
Dis na di promise wey e promise us: di life wey no dey end.
I don write dis things to una concerning those wey dey deceive una.

As for una, di anointing wey una receive from am dey stay inside una, and una no need make anybody teach una. But as im anointing dey teach una about everything, and e na true and no be lie, and just as e teach una, una go stay inside am.
Now, pikin dem, stay inside am, so that when e show, we go get boldness and no go shrink back from am with shame for im coming.
If una know say e righteous, una know say everybody wey do righteousness don born from am.
Look wetin kind love Papa God don give us, say dem go call us God pikin dem! And na so we be. Because of dis, di world no know us, because e no know am.
Beloved, now we na God pikin dem, and e never show wetin we go be. We know say if e show, we go be like am, because we go see am as e be.
Everybody wey get dis hope inside am dey keep im own life pure, even as e pure.
Everybody wey dey sin dey break law also, and sin na lawlessness.
Una know say e show so that e go take away our sins, and no sin dey inside am.
Nobody wey stay inside am dey sin. Nobody wey dey sin don see am or know am.
Pikin dem, make nobody deceive una. Anybody wey do righteousness na righteous, even as e righteous.
Anybody wey dey sin na from di devil, because di devil dey sin from di beginning. For dis reason God Pikin show, so that e go destroy di works of di devil.
Anybody wey born from God no dey sin, because im seed dey stay inside am, and e no fit sin, because e don born from God.
By dis God pikin dem and di devil pikin dem dey clear: anybody wey no dey do righteousness no be from God, and di one wey no love im brother too.
For dis na di message wey una hear from di beginning, say make we love each other;
no be like Cain, wey belong to di evil one and kill im brother. And why e kill am? Because im works evil, and im brother own righteous.
No wonder, my brothers, if di world hate una.
We know say we don pass from death enter life, because we love di brothers. Anybody wey no love im brother dey stay inside death.
Anybody wey hate im brother na murderer, and una know say no murderer get life wey no dey end dey stay inside am.
By dis we know love, because e lay down im life for us. We also suppose lay down our lives for di brothers.
But anybody wey get dis world goods and see im brother wey dey need, and close im heart against am, how God love go dey stay inside am?
My pikin dem, make we no love with word or with tongue only, but with action and truth.
By dis we go know say we dey of di truth, and we go calm our hearts before am,
because if our heart condemn us, God pass our heart, and e know everything.
Beloved, if our heart no condemn us, we get boldness toward God;
and whatever we ask, we dey receive from am, because we dey obey im commandments and dey do di things wey dey please am.
Dis na im commandment: make we believe for di name of im Pikin Jesus Christ, and love each other, even as e give us commandment.
Anybody wey obey im commandments dey stay inside God, and God dey stay inside am. By dis we know say e dey stay inside us, by di Spirit wey e give us.
Beloved, no believe every spirit, but test di spirits, whether dem come from God, because plenty false prophets don go out enter di world.
By dis una go know God Spirit: every spirit wey confess say Jesus Christ don come inside flesh na from God,
and every spirit wey no confess Jesus no be from God. Dis na di spirit of di antichrist, wey una don hear say e dey come, and now e don dey inside di world already.
Una na from God, pikin dem, and una don overcome dem, because di one wey dey inside una pass di one wey dey inside di world.
Dem na from di world. Because of dis, dem dey talk wetin belong to di world, and di world dey listen to dem.
We na from God. Anybody wey know God dey listen to us. Anybody wey no be from God no dey listen to us. By dis we know di spirit of truth and di spirit of error.
Beloved, make we love each other, for love na from God, and everybody wey love don born from God and know God.
Anybody wey no love no know God, for God na love.
By dis God love show among us, say God send im only Pikin enter di world so that we go live through am.
Inside dis na love: no be say we love God, but say e love us and send im Pikin to be di sacrifice for our sins.
Beloved, if God love us so, we also suppose love each other.
Nobody don ever see God. If we love each other, God dey stay inside us, and im love don reach perfection inside us.
By dis we know say we dey stay inside am and e dey stay inside us, because e don give us of im Spirit.
We don see and we dey bear witness say Papa God don send di Pikin to be Saviour of di world.
Anybody wey confess say Jesus na God Pikin, God dey stay inside am, and e dey stay inside God.
We don know and believe di love wey God get for us. God na love, and anybody wey dey stay inside love dey stay inside God, and God dey stay inside am.
By dis love don reach perfection with us, so that we go get boldness for di day of judgment, because as e be, so we be for dis world.
Fear no dey inside love, but perfect love dey drive fear out, because fear get punishment. Anybody wey dey fear never reach perfection inside love.
We love, because e first love us.
If anybody talk say, “I love God,” and e hate im brother, e na liar; for anybody wey no love im brother wey e don see, e no fit love God wey e never see.
Dis commandment we get from am, say anybody wey love God suppose love im brother also.
Everybody wey believe say Jesus na di Christ don born from God. Everybody wey love di one wey born am dey love di one wey born from am also.
By dis we know say we love God pikin dem: when we love God and obey im commandments.
For dis na di love of God, say we obey im commandments. Im commandments no heavy.
For everything wey born from God dey overcome di world. Dis na di victory wey don overcome di world: our faith.
Who be di one wey overcome di world, if no be di one wey believe say Jesus na God Pikin?
Dis na di one wey come through water and blood, Jesus Christ; no be with water only, but with water and with blood. Di Spirit na di one wey dey bear witness, because di Spirit na di truth.
For three dey bear witness for heaven: Papa God, di Word, and Holy Spirit, and dis three na one.
Three dey bear witness for earth: di Spirit, di water, and di blood, and di three agree as one.
If we receive di witness of men, di witness of God pass am, for dis na di witness of God wey e don bear concerning im Pikin.
Anybody wey believe for God Pikin get di witness inside am. Anybody wey no believe God don make am liar, because e no believe di witness wey God bear concerning im Pikin.
Dis na di witness: God don give us life wey no dey end, and dis life dey inside im Pikin.
Anybody wey get di Pikin get di life. Anybody wey no get God Pikin no get di life.
I don write dis things to una wey believe for di name of God Pikin, so that una go know say una get life wey no dey end, and so that una go continue to believe for di name of God Pikin.
Dis na di boldness wey we get toward am, say if we ask anything according to im will, e dey hear us.
If we know say e dey hear us, whatever we ask, we know say we don get di requests wey we ask from am.

If anybody see im brother dey commit sin wey no lead to death, make e ask, and God go give am life for dem wey dey sin wey no lead to death. Sin dey wey lead to death. I no talk say make e pray about dat one.
All unrighteousness na sin, and sin dey wey no lead to death.
We know say anybody wey born from God no dey sin, but di one wey born from God dey guard im own self, and di evil one no dey touch am.
We know say we na from God, and di whole world dey under di power of di evil one.
We know say God Pikin don come, and e don give us understanding, so that we go know di true one. We dey inside di true one, inside im Pikin Jesus Christ. Dis na di true God and life wey no dey end.
Pikin dem, make una keep una own selves from idols. Amen.
